cards.text: Paul, an apostle, is writing to the churches of Galatia, where some people are trying to distort the gospel of Christ (Galatians 1:1-2, 7). Now he wants these brothers to know something about the gospel he preached to them. So where DID it come from?

cards.question: Where does Paul say he received the gospel he preached to the Galatians?

answers.text: From the teachers of the Law
From the elders of the churches

cards.text: Then Paul brings up something the Galatians have already heard about: his former way of life in Judaism.

cards.question: Back in his former way of life, what did Paul do to the church of God?

answers.text: Persecuted it and tried to destroy it
Joined it and taught its people
Left it alone and moved away

cards.question: Paul describes himself back in Judaism. He says he was extremely ___ for the traditions of his fathers.
True or false: Paul says that in Judaism he was falling behind most of the people his own age.

cards.text: But then God steps in, the God who set Paul apart from his mother's womb and called him by His grace. Paul's out here running full speed the WRONG way, friend, and God had set him apart from his MOTHER'S WOMB!

cards.question: God was pleased to reveal His Son in Paul, the man who used to persecute the church. Why? So that Paul might preach Him among the ___.

cards.text: So God has just revealed His Son in Paul. Friend, that is a BIG moment. What does a man do right after THAT?

cards.question: God has revealed His Son in Paul. True or false: Paul rushes off to consult with people about it.
Paul doesn't go up to Jerusalem to the apostles who came before him either. So where does he go?

answers.text: Into Arabia and later back to Damascus
Into Egypt and later back to Joppa
Into Macedonia and later back to Antioch

cards.text: Only after three years does Paul go up to Jerusalem, and he stays fifteen days. THREE YEARS, friend, and I can't wait three minutes for a cookie to cool!

cards.question: When Paul finally goes up to Jerusalem, who does he go to confer with?
Cephas is Peter, one of Jesus' apostles (Matthew 10:2; John 1:42). True or false: besides Cephas, the only one Paul mentions seeing on that trip is James, the Lord's brother.

cards.text: Then Paul stops and says, "I assure you before God that what I am writing to you is no lie." When a man says THAT, you put the cookie down and LISTEN.

cards.question: After his time in Jerusalem, where does Paul later go?

answers.text: The regions of Syria and Cilicia
The regions of Pontus and Bithynia
The regions of Galatia and Phrygia

cards.question: Paul is off in Syria and Cilicia now. True or false: the churches of Judea know Paul personally.

cards.text: So the churches in Judea only know Paul by the story going around about him. And friend, it's the kind of news that makes a whole group chat go, "WAIT. WHAT?"

cards.question: Here's the story the churches of Judea hear: The man who formerly persecuted us is now ___ the faith he once tried to destroy.
When the churches of Judea hear that story about Paul, what do they do?

answers.text: They glorify God because of Paul
They send men to question Paul
